What The Hell Is Wrong With Will Smith's Male Spawn?
Jaden Smith is at it again — and this time, basic meteorology has him completely losing his mind.
A wildly viral video making the rounds on X has the internet in stitches over the actor-rapper’s bizarre reaction to a hailstorm in Paris.
The clip shows the 27-year-old standing in the street catching ice pellets in his hands like they’re rare diamonds falling from the sky.
“I’m catching little snowflakes in my hand bro,” Smith says with wide-eyed wonder. Then comes the philosophical deep dive: “But to bounce rain in ice form off my body?”
As if that weren’t enough, the heavily edited clip cuts to other moments of Smith declaring “My mind’s blowing… my mind’s getting blown… it’s blowing my mind, bro” while staring into the distance like he just discovered fire.
The caption says it all: “This man’s brain should be studied.”At 27 years old, the son of Will Smith and Jada Pinkett Smith is still acting like a sheltered kid who just stepped outside for the first time. The original footage from earlier this year already had people scratching their heads when Smith appeared genuinely shocked that “ice is falling from the sky” during what was clearly a normal hailstorm.
You’re not supposed to be able to catch rain in your hand? Tell that to every kid who’s ever played in the rain, Jaden.
The internet had a field day. One commenter nailed it: “It’s what happens when your kid is retarded but you have a lot of money so you call him an ‘artist’ instead.” Another compared the whole thing to a Key & Peele sketch. Ouch.
This isn’t exactly new territory for Smith. The guy has spent years dropping head-scratching quotes about time, the universe, and his own supposed genius. He’s the same dude who once said he doesn’t believe in time and dressed like a Victorian orphan at red carpets.
Raised in the Hollywood bubble with unlimited resources and zero real-world guardrails, it’s almost impressive how disconnected he seems from everyday life. Most people experience hail by the time they’re in elementary school. Jaden apparently needs a full existential crisis over it.
The video has people wondering what exactly goes on in the Smith household. Between Jada’s endless tabloid drama and Will’s public image management, it’s no wonder the kids turned out… unique.
